name: NBHD sautai Tools
description: Async meal-plan generation backed by sautai's M2M API via the NBHD runtime proxy (Phase 0).

apiBaseUrl.description: Override NBHD API base URL. Defaults to NBHD_API_BASE_URL env var.

requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for the NBHD runtime endpoint request — the fast ack only, never the slow sautai generation itself.
